items: dash cam with buffered parking mode (front + rear)
camera-specific hardwire kit with low-voltage cutoff (e.g. Viofo HK4 for A229 series)
add-a-circuit fuse taps sized to the car's fuse type (ATO / mini / low-profile mini / micro2)
OBD-II plug-and-play power cable (alternative to hardwire)
dedicated dash cam battery pack (alternative for long parking)
why: ChatGPT says most dash cams need a hardwire kit or dedicated battery to record after the engine is off, and it asks whether the shopper will hardwire, which splits shoppers into hardwire, OBD plug-and-play, and battery-pack setups. Which set works depends on facts a shopper can get wrong: the power plug and kit must match the camera (Viofo HK4 vs HK3), the fuse-tap type must match the car's fuse box, and the low-voltage cutoff must be set to protect the car battery; Amazon can hold any of these sets in one cart, and ChatGPT showed no card for a set.
